# CfC provenance

The files `torch_cfc.py`, `README.md`, and `LICENSE` were copied without modification from the local checkout of:

- Repository: https://github.com/raminmh/CfC.git
- Commit: `3ebaa0307a280c5a9ee8261fdf733ad9bd5636ad`
- License: Apache License 2.0

Only the PyTorch implementation and its provenance files were migrated. Datasets, TensorFlow examples, MATLAB figures, the nested Git directory, and generated data were intentionally excluded.

An identical copy of `torch_cfc.py`, together with the license and notice,
is vendored under `src/ca_lsc_td3/_vendor/` so installed packages can import
the reference implementation without a project-specific `PYTHONPATH` entry.
